name: hcapp_getChatRooms
description: The global chat rooms THIS hasher may enter, each with its unread count, participation state and pin state — one call, whatever the rooms happen to be. The phone asks the server which rooms it has rather than holding a hard-coded list, so appending a row to HC6.ChatRoomCatalog() reaches every installed app with no release (James, 2026-09-14). Zero rows is the normal answer for a hasher who holds none of the roles. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 106, standard token). Authorization: per room, HC6.UserMayEnterChatRoom(@userId, RoomType) = 1 — the same gate the room message SPs use, so a listed room can never then be refused. participationState per room (HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts.ParticipationState, James 2026-09-14): 0 participate with push, 1 participate badges only, 2 opted out; opted-out rooms are omitted unless @includeOptedOut = 1 (the settings console passes 1 so opting out is not a one-way door). Rooms default to PINNED; a set bit in HC.Hasher.UnpinnedMismanagementRooms ('mm' rooms) or UnpinnedAppAccessRooms ('flags' / 'platform' / 'beta' rooms) means the hasher unpinned it (E9.F1.S8). Read-only.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

parameters.name: includeOptedOut
parameters.description: 1 also returns rooms the hasher has opted OUT of (ParticipationState 2) — the settings console; 0 (default) omits them — the chat list.

rowsets.description: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth: 1206 invalid token / errorType 1, 1306 device not registered / 3, 1206 signed out / 7) returns the error detail ALONE. An unhandled error is logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-raised with THROW (no envelope).

rowsets.name: Rooms
rowsets.description: On success: one row per room the hasher may enter, ORDER BY sortOrder. Zero rows is normal.

columns.name: roomType
columns.description: ChatRoomCatalog.RoomType — the value stored in HC.EventMessage.MessageType for the room's messages (1 Kennel Admins, 2 Grand Masters, 3 Hash Cash, 4 Religious Advisors, 5 Hare Raisers, 6 Web & Social Media, 7 Platform Admins, 8 Beta Testers as of 2026-10-13).

columns.name: roomIcon
columns.description: ChatRoomCatalog.IconUrl — the room's coin as a full blob URL. NULL = no art yet; the client draws its own glyph.

columns.name: sortOrder
columns.description: ChatRoomCatalog.SortOrder; the rowset is already in this order.

columns.name: unreadCount
columns.description: Count of live (Removed = 0) room messages by OTHER people with MessageSequenceCount above the hasher's badge row LastSequenceCount (0 if no badge row).

columns.name: newestSequenceCount
columns.description: MAX(MessageSequenceCount) of the room's live messages, 0 if none.

columns.name: participationState
columns.description: ISNULL(badge.ParticipationState, 0): 0 participate with push, 1 badges only, 2 opted out (only when @includeOptedOut = 1).

columns.name: pinned
columns.description: 1 pinned (default), 0 when the hasher's unpin mirror bit for the room is set (Hasher.UnpinnedMismanagementRooms & GrantMask for 'mm' rooms; Hasher.UnpinnedAppAccessRooms & GrantMask for 'flags' / 'platform' / 'beta' rooms).

sideEffects: None on success. INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW on an unhandled error.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
